subject: Preserving HEALIX evaluation access while PO is in flight
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <procurement@healixlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Preserving HEALIX evaluation access while PO is in flight

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Heard from your finance team that the PO for the Dedicated pilot is routed but not yet approved (totally understood). We don’t want the team at Healix to lose momentum while the purchase order clears.

Quick proposal: Redwood can provision a short, complementary evaluation buffer to keep your sandbox and API routes live until the PO is processed. We typically do this as a one-time token grant tied to the existing trial project and expire it automatically once the PO is processed or at the agreed end date — whichever comes first.

Suggested parameters:
- Duration: 7 days from activation
- Scope: sandbox + API usage, non-production only
- Token grant: 100,000 tokens (covering typical integration tests + demo runs)

If that works for you, reply here and I’ll route for approval. I’ve attached an updated proposal and the quote summary for your finance team to reference (redwood_proposal_v2.pdf, quote_summary.xlsx).

If you’d prefer a different amount/duration we can adjust. The goal is to keep your engineers unblocked while procurement finishes.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0187

Attachment: redwood_proposal_v2.pdf (PDF), quote_summary.xlsx (Excel)
From: Alex Turner <procurement@healixlabs.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Preserving HEALIX evaluation access while PO is in flight

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the offer and for sending the proposal. We appreciate the flexibility — finance is doing a multi-level review and estimates the PO will be released by end of next week, but I don’t have an exact ETA yet.

A couple of clarifying questions before I confirm with the team:
1) Will the temporary grant have any billing implications once the PO is processed (i.e., will we be invoiced for the granted tokens if we use them)?
2) Can you lock the grant to the project so it cannot be used beyond the non-prod sandbox routes?

If you can confirm those two items and provide a short approval note we can share internally.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Procurement | Healix Labs
procurement@healixlabs.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <procurement@healixlabs.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Preserving HEALIX evaluation access while PO is in flight

Alex —

Short answers: yes and yes.

1) The complimentary token grant is provided at Redwood’s discretion. We will not invoice Healix for the tokens granted as part of this specifically approved stopgap. Once your PO is processed we will switch billing to the committed contract terms and reconcile only usages beyond the complimentary grant if you elect to continue at paid rates — but that does not change any financial obligation for the in-flight PO.
2) We will tie the grant to the Healix pilot project and restrict it to non-production routes. Our engineer on duty will configure the project scope and enforce route-level restrictions.

Approval: I have signed off on a 7-day, 100,000-token grant for Healix Labs (approval id: RW-APPR-2026-1147). Please consider this approved by Redwood Sales leadership. I’ve attached a short internal approval note for your records (approval_note.txt).

Olga — please proceed to provision and ping legal if they need a short amendment.

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, North America Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachment: approval_note.txt
